Name: Avian's Raccoon Trash Bear
Author: AvianRPG
Description:
Ever want the Trash Bear to look like their forest neighbors? Then this mod is for you!

It's a simple CP image replacement mod so I don't anticipate any bugs, but Please let me know if you find any!

The one thing I did find is that in the case of world recolors you will want to confirm that the two aren't in conflict. I haven't had a chance to test with all the recolors yet but I am making a list so I can update the manifest dependencies at a later date. For now I believe if you load the Trash Bear after the recolor, it should work fine.

Downloads.Description: A cute raccoon sprite replacement mod for the Trash Bear.
